units.source_text: 所有这一切都是在无言中进行。

en.t: All of this took place in silence.

units.source_text: 我们默默地低下头来，老师几乎没有反应。

en.t: We silently lowered our heads, and the teacher barely reacted.

units.source_text: 只听见老师和副司走在台阶上的咯咯咯咯的木屣声，越走距我越远。

en.t: All I could hear was the clacking sound of the teacher and the assistant priest's wooden clogs on the steps, growing farther and farther away from me.

units.source_text: 我们一直目送到完全看不见他们的背影。

en.t: We kept watching them until their backs had completely disappeared from sight.
This was the etiquette of the Zen household.
